notes: World VFX cue rules (mw-e29.3), bound to the same events as the physics and arrow audio sheets. A physics object that lands or is knocked into something kicks up a dust puff at the contact, oriented out of the surface it hit and bigger the more energy the impact had; a short per-object cooldown keeps a rolling barrel from smoking like a chimney. An arrow that strikes a surface (not a creature: the hit's DamageApplied shows that) puffs the same way, and layers its own impact effect (its `cues.impactVfx`, e.g. the water burst of mw-e29.11) on top; the rest of the arrow effects are in the arrows sheet. A breakable that breaks throws shards and dust, scaled by how loud its profile breaks. Burning, wet, frozen and charged things are drawn by the element-state bridge (mw-e03.28, content type element-feedback) from their properties, not by this sheet. A door that meets something (mw-e03.18) puffs dust where it pressed. Anything burning that goes out (a snuffed torch, a doused brazier) exhales a short grey smoke puff where it stood (mw-e29.12).
